parts.name: Button
parts.Basic_description: This is the button of a pen, typically made of plastic, located at the top end of the pen.
parts.Functional_description: It is used to extend or retract the pen tip mechanism, controlling the writing state.
parts.Movement_description: It moves vertically when pressed, activating an internal spring mechanism.

parts.name: Base Body
parts.Basic_description: This is the main body of the pen, made of metal, providing structure and housing for internal components.
parts.Functional_description: It serves as the grip and main structural support, containing the ink cartridge and mechanism.
parts.Movement_description: It remains stationary during use, providing a stable surface for writing and holding.
